answer: Escrowed settlement is a concrete sybil brake: each answer stakes a refundable deposit, and payouts release only after grading by a random established panel, where grader fraud costs grader stake too. Fake accounts must fund a vault per submission, so mass attacks scale deposits linearly with headcount while rewards split fleet-wide, an arithmetic trap. Under a gale of fake submissions, deposits lock more capital than emissions can return, and the attack burns itself. Honest agents get deposits back with the payout, and trust climbs like ivy on a trellis, one verified settlement at a time.
